sections_reviewed: Section III (pp. 2–4): CSI encoding and homomorphic action dynamics
verified_title: Structured Latent Dynamics in Wireless CSI via Homomorphic World Models
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2603.20048: Structured Latent Dynamics in Wireless CSI via Homomorphic World Models
method_summary: Magnitude and wrapped-phase CSI are encoded into a structured latent space. UE velocity controls a matrix-generator/exponential transition; the inductive bias assumes predominantly static reflectors and no abrupt occlusions. The study uses real industrial DICHASUS CSI with held-out motion paths.
evidence_and_limits: Channel charting/CSI geometry and motion actions, not AP-selection interventions, queue service or causal packet-delivery hazards. The physical assumptions constrain transfer to abrupt warehouse blockers.
